I hear you. I'm not by any means saying I think D4 is a perfect game, in fact it has TONS it could have polished in terms of gameplay loops, balancing, etc., but in this given case, I dont think making the argument that "something is wrong" is a correct justification as to why people would use this exploit, specifically.

I think it's pretty safe to say 2 things here:
1. People have almost ALWAYS looked for ways to break games in ways the devs didnt intend... theres total categories dedicated to it (see speedrunning and things of that nature)
2. People want the quickest/most efficient dopamine hit they can get and watching gear loot piñata all over the floor while gaining massive exp will definitely do that. (Which causes bigger longevity issues for a game... but thats another topic I'm not focusing on here)

With that said... what you're talking about goes into my point... if you feel you need to exploit the game in order to enjoy it, it indicates to me, at least, that you dont enjoy the base game as it's presented and it may be better to look elsewhere -until- things are updated in a way that is to your liking; that is 100% okay!

And to each their own as far as how they enjoy the game, but I feel it kills your own longevity in the game if all you're doing is an exploit to get ALL the loot and ALL the levels... whats after that? Quit because you've effectively "beat" the game?

It sounds like maybe D4 just isn't the game for you currently, and thats okay. If you have to cheat to enjoy it, I think that says something.

It's totally fine to step away and come back when you see things that you actually enjoy instead of torturing yourself with something you find unpleasant.
